summary: First modern-architecture (Qwen2) support in the custom out-of-core streamed CPU decoder: NeoX RoPE + Q/K/V projection biases + architecture-aware metadata validation, delegating all quantized math to the pinned ggml traits. Genuine streamed inference on a real Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct GGUF matches the resident llama.cpp reference under teacher forcing; out-of-core weight streaming and existing llama/Stories support preserved.

implementation_commits: e613dcc feat(streamed): qwen2 architecture support and teacher-forced logit FFI
git.working_tree: clean except untracked .vscode/ (plus this evidence file)
git.note: Evidence produced against the committed implementation source above.

environment.host: Windows 11 + WSL2 Ubuntu, Intel i5-12400F, CPU-only

architecture_audit.decoder_was: llama-only: hardcoded general.architecture==llama, llama.* key allowlist, mandatory llama.rope.dimension_count, normal consecutive-pair RoPE, no projection bias, per-layer tensor count = 9.

qwen2_requirements_found_in_pinned_refer.rope_type: LLAMA_ROPE_TYPE_NEOX (src/llama-model.cpp:3700) - pairs offset by n_rot/2; theta_scale = freq_base^(-2/n_dims), theta accumulated per pair from pos (ggml-cpu/ops.cpp rope_cache_init + rotate_pairs).
qwen2_requirements_found_in_pinned_refer.qkv_bias: separate Q/K/V path adds wq_b/wk_b/wv_b right after projection, before RoPE (llama-graph.cpp build_qkv:1897-1906; model loader src/models/qwen2.cpp create_tensor_qkv).
qwen2_requirements_found_in_pinned_refer.gqa: grouped-query attention (14 query heads / 2 kv heads) - already supported by the streamed attention loop.
qwen2_requirements_found_in_pinned_refer.rope_dimension_count: qwen2 GGUF omits the key; reference defaults n_rot to head_dim.
qwen2_requirements_found_in_pinned_refer.tied_embeddings: qwen2.5-0.5B has no output.weight; output = token_embd - already handled.
qwen2_requirements_found_in_pinned_refer.activation_and_norm: LLM_FFN_SILU + LLM_FFN_PAR (SwiGLU) and RMSNorm - identical to llama.

architecture_audit.implemented: Typed ArchSpec{prefix, neox_rope, qkv_bias}; metadata allowlist built from prefix; optional rope.dimension_count (must equal head_dim when present); NeoX branch in rope(); add_bias() after q/k/v matvec; per-layer tensor count 12 for qwen2; capability comment updated. No hand-written quant kernels; dequant/matvec remain pinned ggml traits.

teacher_forced_multi_position.method: resident greedy sequence is canonical; its argmax tokens fed to the streamed decoder so every position shares an identical prefix (valid even past independent-greedy divergence). CLI: logit-diff --max-tokens 16 --teacher-forced.

divergence_position.interpretation: single borderline flip; reference token stays in streamed top-10 (rank 1) - FP32 precision, not structural

numerical_parity.root_cause: The streamed custom FP32 forward pass differs from the llama.cpp graph only by permissible floating-point accumulation order. RMSE (0.089 Q8_0, 0.136 Q4_K_M) is in the same regime as the already-validated llama/Stories path (Stories Q8_0 ~0.185). Divergence is confined to isolated borderline-logit greedy flips where the reference token remains in the streamed top-10; teacher-forced positions re-agree after a flip, so there is no cascading/structural error. No defect found; no production correction made.
numerical_parity.acceptance: Numerical equivalence is NOT claimed. Reported: measured per-position errors + top-1/top-k agreement under valid identical-prefix comparison.

bounded_memory.method: streamed backend, --address-space-mb enforces Linux RLIMIT_AS; ctx 64, threads 2, max_tokens 8, workspace 12-16 MB.
bounded_memory.finding: Both run under a 96 MB address-space limit at ~62 MB peak RSS. The footprint is dominated by the 151,936-token vocab-only tokenizer load (token + merge strings), NOT the model weights - so the floor is higher than the small-vocab Stories models (64 MB) despite smaller weights. Out-of-core weight streaming holds: RSS is decoupled from the 398-531 MB model file.
bounded_memory.note: RLIMIT_AS is a process address-space bound, not physical RAM; WSL2 is not a 2 GB device.

io_read_amplification.method: streamed --metrics, ctx 64, threads 2, max_tokens 8, cache disabled (cache_bytes 0).
io_read_amplification.analysis: Each forward pass re-streams the full weight set (no persistent weight residency), so source bytes ~= passes x model payload. For Q8_0 at 8 generated tokens + prefill the ~5.35 GB read vs ~525 MB weights is ~10x read amplification, matching the documented synchronous per-token re-stream design. This is the measured requirement input for a future remote range-read transport (not implemented here); it is a security dependency (consumption-time re-read authenticates against mutation), so it is not eliminated.
io_read_amplification.remote_transport_implication: A remote source would need ~model_payload x tokens bandwidth per request under this design, or a verified bounded cache / sealed-manifest staged-range mechanism to reduce it.

limitations: Only Qwen2.5-0.5B tested; other Qwen2 sizes, GQA ratios, and non-tied-output variants untested.
Address-space floor (~96 MB) is set by the large tokenizer vocabulary, not weights; larger enforced limits (512/1024/2048 MB) have ample headroom but were not individually swept.
No synthetic unsupported-architecture GGUF integration test added; rejection is enforced by resolve_arch and the metadata allowlist (code-level).
cgroup memory.max enforcement and CPU-affinity pinning not applied; Windows MSVC native lane not run.
qwen3/llama-3/gemma and RoPE scaling (YaRN/linear) remain unimplemented and are rejected.
